lastResponse.text: First: if your breathing feels dangerous right now, call 9…1…1 immediately. If you can still make one call safely, use 5…4…1…6…8…2…1…0…0…1. If we get cut off, do those in that order. You can keep it brief: “I’m short of breath and need help now.”
